title: HALO: Hierarchical Evidence Selection and Reinforcement Learning for Allocating Budgeted Label Optimization from Longitudinal Clinical Records
abstract: arXiv:2611.00986v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Learning from extensive longitudinal clinical records--spanning repeated encounters, evolving conditions, and heterogeneous documentation--under a finite labeling budget requires solving two coupled problems: deciding what evidence to keep and deciding which patients deserve higher-fidelity labels. Prior work on active learning and multi-fidelity label acquisition mainly addresses the second problem, while treating the evidence presented to the acquisition policy as fixed. We present HALO, a Hierarchical Evidence Selection and Reinforcement Learning pipeline for Allocating Budgeted Label Optimization from Longitudinal Clinical Records. This framework jointly learns what to read and what label source to acquire under budget. HALO first selects informative evidence from longitudinal records and then uses a budget-aware policy to allocate free-, silver-, and gold-fidelity label sources. translated_title: HALO：基于分层证据选择与强化学习的纵向临床记录预算约束标签优化分配
translated_abstract: 在有限的标注预算下，从大规模纵向临床记录（涵盖多次就诊、病情演变和异构文档）中学习，需要解决两个相互耦合的问题：决定保留哪些证据，以及决定哪些患者值得更高保真度的标签。以往关于主动学习和多保真度标签获取的研究主要解决第二个问题，而将呈现给获取策略的证据视为固定的。我们提出了HALO，一个用于从纵向临床记录中分配预算约束标签优化的分层证据选择与强化学习框架。该框架在预算约束下联合学习“读取什么”以及“获取哪种标签来源”。HALO首先从纵向记录中选择信息量大的证据，然后使用预算感知策略来分配免费级、银级和金级三种保真度的标签来源。对于冻结策略，我们的理论刻画了不对称……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: HALO框架通过分层证据选择与预算感知的强化学习，在有限标注预算下联合学习从纵向临床记录中筛选关键证据，并智能分配免费、银级、金级三种保真度的标签来源，解决了以往研究将证据视为固定输入的局限。
en_tdlr: HALO jointly learns what evidence to read and which label fidelity to acquire under a finite budget, combining hierarchical evidence selection with budget-aware reinforcement learning to overcome prior work's assumption of fixed evidence inputs for longitudinal clinical records.
